title: Konu nguu hawri e loopal fiyoowo
intro: E jamaanu ko adii Annabi Muhammadu, laamɗo doole ummoriiɗo Yemen waɗii kampaañ konu ngam halkude nokku ceniɗo to Makka. Oo gaño ardii konu mawngu timmungu e kulle hare, hoolaare e doole mum en e keewal mum en. Kono tan, yahdu maɓɓe maa joof ɗoon e ɗoon nde ɓe kawri e naatgol Alla ngol ɓe cikkaani. Mbele aɗa waawi anndude hol jokkondirɗo e ndee hiisa kaawningol ?
clues: Min njahdi e konu mawngu e kulle hare doole, feewde galle ceniɗo oo
Min njiɗnoo ko ruttaade e halkude nokku dewal mo maccuɓe yurmeende mawnde mahi
Koɗorɗe colli tokoosi neldaa e amen, ina njogii kaaƴe loope e nder daande mum en e ƴiye mum en
Min kawri e sawtawol ngol werlii e dow amen kaaƴe, ngol wayli min e heddiiɓe e taƴde
Mi ummiima leydi Yemen, mi golliima e les laamɗo ɗaɓɓoowo to挑衅 nokku ceniɗo
En mbaɗaama yeru wonande ɓeen cuusɓe desafío nokku ceniɗo Alla
